The story relies heavily on well-worn cliches, both in its overarching plot and in its specific details and expressions. The premise of ex-partners meeting awkwardly in a café to return a box of leftover belongings is a very common trope. Furthermore, the text uses several overused expressions and stage directions, such as "Man lernt ja aus Fehlern" (you learn from mistakes), "Aber wer zählt schon" (but who's counting), and the classic description "ihr Lächeln erreicht die Augen nicht" (her smile doesn't reach her eyes). Because it relies on these predictable elements, it is not a piece without cliches.
